description.text:
In this role, you will work within Cadence’s R&D team, developing and maintaining software code written in C++. Your role will be of an individual contributor in the team, writing high-quality, high-performance, architecturally-sound software. This is a good opportunity to solve challenging problems in this area, using state of the art technology with professionals all over the globe.
We need experienced software developers to enhance and maintain the platform we use to provide products to our customers. You are expected to be well versed in software programming, independent, and to follow good coding practices. You must have good problem solving and debugging skills. If you see yourself enabling the work that pushes the frontiers of Computer Science and Engineering, this position was made for you!
You will also have the opportunity to collaborate on projects integrating artificial intelligence technologies aimed at enhancing the user experience and automating advanced features.
Job Responsibilities:
- Contribute to the development of the Virtuoso Heterogenous Integration product.
- Deliver a smooth, intuitive, and high‑performance design environment to our customers worldwide allowing to create advanced multi-fabric systems.
Job Requirements:
- Good foundations in C++ (structures, pointers, object‑oriented programming)
- Interest and/or experience in parallel and multi-thread programming
- Ability to work in a team, learn quickly, and adapt to a demanding technical environment.
- Knowledge of the design of IC, PCB and System-In-Package would be a valuable plus
- Knowledge in the R/F design would also be a plus
Job Qualifications:
- Graduate from an engineering school or university program in computer science or equivalent.
- Previous experience in C++ development is appreciated.
- Curiosity, rigor, creativity, and initiative.
** English CV for application is required. Please upload your CV. Thank you.**
